get.description: Every track gets an entry, also with no ticks, in track list order. Each is worked out up to the earliest of `to`, `today` and, for an archived track, its archive date; later ticks are ignored. With `from`, every day of the period from `from` takes part (unticked days at its start are a break), and streaks and breaks crossing either edge are cut there. Includes private tracks. Check the `statsPeriod` capability before sending `from` or `to`: older servers ignore them and answer all-time stats.

parameters.name: today
parameters.description: The client's date (YYYY-MM-DD); the server's date if omitted

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The period's first day (YYYY-MM-DD); from the first tick if omitted

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The period's last day (YYYY-MM-DD); up to today if omitted

parameters.name: trackId
parameters.description: One track only (also an archived one); 0 for all tracks

parameters.name: includeRuns
parameters.description: Add every streak and break to each entry

parameters.name: includeArchived
parameters.description: With all tracks, include archived ones

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

400.description: Today, from or to is not a valid date, or from is after to

401.description: Current user is not logged in
